title: The Spine
question: Which part of the spine is it?
lines: Seven small bones hold up your head. Which part of the spine?
Watch the glowing section at the top of the spine.
Which part of the spine is glowing?
The lumbar section is the low back, with larger bones.
The seven glowing vertebrae are in the neck.
Why it matters: it lets your head nod, tilt and turn.

title: The Spine
question: How many bones are glowing?
lines: The low back carries the most weight. How many bones is it?
Watch the glowing section of the lower spine.
How many vertebrae are in the glowing section?
The neck has seven, and the rib-bearing mid-back has twelve.
The lumbar spine, in the low back, usually has five of the biggest.
Why it matters: big vertebrae carry much of your upper body's weight.
